style.styleTitle: Lights4fun 1.5m Pre Lit Christmas Joy Garland
style.toneOfVoice: Spread some Christmas cheer throughout your home with this beautiful garland. The 1.5m Pre Lit Christmas Joy Garland helps you and your family celebrate in style. It’s that time of year again, and the garland is still unparalleled for keeping your spirits up through the chilly season. This lush pre lit Christmas garland is abounding in visual interest. Red and green faux foliage is dotted with big pinecones and 50 LEDs. The pre-lit Christmas garland can be programmed to illuminate every evening at the same time, with the optional 6-hour timer. There s also a constant ‘on’ mode. The discreet clear cable blends into the background, showcasing the shine which will help you get through those long winter nights. Dimensions (mm): Height: 1500 Width: 1500 Depth: 1500
